hook: Ben asks Anna about job interviews.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Have you ever had a job interview?

translation.vi: Bạn đã từng đi phỏng vấn xin việc bao giờ chưa?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Yes, I have. I work at a school.

translation.vi: Có, mình từng rồi. Mình làm ở trường học.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I have never had a job interview.

translation.vi: Mình chưa bao giờ đi phỏng vấn xin việc.

gloss.en: a meeting where someone asks you questions to see if you are right for a job
an activity that you do, often for money
the regular work that you do to earn money

grammar_notes: Use 'ever' in present perfect questions and 'never' in present perfect negatives to talk about life experience.
interaction_prompts: Have you ever had a job interview? Tell us about it.
